# Raggio Gourmet & Pizza

> Independent pizzeria in Newark, Delaware serving brick-oven gourmet pizza made with 100% Grande Mozzarella, thick-crust Sicilian squares, Philly-style cheesesteaks, chicken wings, strombolis, pasta, Latin dishes and group catering. Pickup and delivery. Online checkout is processed by our sister kitchen, Philly Style Express ("Philly Express"), on the FoodTec platform — same kitchen, same address.

## Key facts

- Address: 681 E Chestnut Hill Rd, Newark, DE 19713, United States
- Phone: (302) 369-0553
- Hours: Sunday–Thursday 9:00 AM–9:00 PM; Friday–Saturday 9:00 AM–10:00 PM (America/New_York)
- Service: pickup and delivery; no reservations
- Price range: $$ — Large 16" cheese pizza $15.99; Large 16" gourmet pizza $20.99 (prices verified 2026-09-25)
- Languages: English, Spanish

## Popular items

- The Works Pizza — meat, green pepper, mushrooms, fried onions
- Buffalo Chicken Pizza — grilled chicken, buffalo sauce
- White Special Pizza — spinach, ricotta, mozzarella, fresh garlic sauce
- Sicilian Meat Lover — sausage, ham, pepperoni, bacon on thick Sicilian crust
- Philly Cheesesteak
- Chicken wings — buffalo, BBQ, garlic parm, honey habanero, mango habanero
